title: Deterministic restricted weight query point
statement: Given a restricted-weight input, a set $J$ of coordinates in $ in{n}$, and a query index $q$ from the set of all queries, the deterministic query point is the sign vector in $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ obtained by combining the free assignment for the second component of the query pair with the fixed assignment for its first component, using $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates in the input dimension
caveat: The query-pair, assignment, and sign-cube combination constructions are referenced but not defined in the supplied snippet, so their precise mathematical meanings cannot be made self-contained.
